field_category_validity.note: Inference now masks categories not allowed for the source field.

common_error_patterns: facility setting or care unit misclassified as equipment
generic diagnostic equipment misclassified as laboratory equipment
pediatric care or ICU setting misclassified as neonatal equipment
procedure type confused with care setting, screening, follow-up or marketing
multi-label cases forced into one category
conclusion: The field constraint is fixed, but subtype classification is not accurate enough for a clinical service catalog. For service input, use canonical action alias matching as the primary path and treat subtype labels as routing metadata.
